main.description: A user's post in a group discussion context, stored in the user's personal repo.

groupDid.description: The community/group DID this post belongs to.

segmentUri.description: Optional reference to the group segment being discussed.

listItemUri.description: Optional reference to the group list item being discussed.

parentPostUri.description: Optional reference to parent post for threaded replies.

mentionedDids.description: Array of DIDs mentioned in the post for notifications.

createdAt.description: Timestamp when this post was created.
